{{Quote|We suffered heavy losses at Taral Five: the Dantooine, the ''Serroco''... more starfighters than I care to count.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Prisoner|the ''Telos''}}</ref>}}
The '''''Dantooine''''' was a warship in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that was under [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Oteg]]'s command at [[Taral V]] in the early days of the [[Galactic War]]. It was destroyed at the [[Battle of Taral V]].<ref name="TOR" /> Like the [[Serroco (starship)|''Serroco'']] and the [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']], it was named after [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] devastated during the [[Jedi Civil War]].
